evidence.evidence_text: In this paper, to mitigate the above issues, we propose \textbf{GAIA}, a \textbf{G}ame-based \textbf{A}dversarial self-play \textbf{I}nter\textbf{A}ctive training paradigm, which constructs an adversarial two-player (a persuader and a resister) zero-sum game and guides the game to approximate Nash Equilibrium (NE) via reinforcement learning (RL) for the non-collaborative dialogues.
